title: actinostemma racemosum
intro: Actinostemma racemosum, commonly known as the cluster-flowered Actinostemma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is a perennial plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, for its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease.
